[quote=irocco;61529472]Ahmed relaxed for a moment as he heard the old man's voice calmly counting. The elder stalled, Ahmed turned to look at him, he saw the abject horror on his face. 

[i]"Are we...?"[/i] The Elder nodded, much to Ahmeds fear.

[i][b]"We need to go back, now!"[/b][/i][/quote]
Grant begins to panick. The plane has already crossed V1, the point of no return for the takeoff. Against his better judgement, he attempts to abort the takeoff, slamming the throttles to idle, feathering the propellers and applying as much brake as he can. Much to their chagrin, the plane does not slow down fast enough, and Grant is forced to continue the roll.

The plane barely gets off the runway, and because of Grant's idiocy, the airplane's left propeller clips some of the antennas at the end. A loud crunch and a bang shakes the entire vehicle, and it immediately starts to veer left. Grant manages to fight the airplane and continues to drag the limping machine up into the air, having dealt with situations like this before. Amongst the pandemonium in the cabin, he calls in a mayday to the tower.

[i]"Edmundsen Tower, this is Whiskey November Golf Foxtrot Alpha, mayday mayday mayday, requesting vectors for immediate arrival."[/i]

The tower instructs them to do a loop around the city, and to come in for landing on the same runway they took off from. Grant obliges, and continues to wrestle with the stricken airplane as they take it for a ride around Edmundsen.

...

On the ground, police and emergency services are waiting for the airplane to arrive. The Air Force base at the airport is also on standby, waiting for the moment for the tower to tell them their bandits are doing the dumb thing and are trying to run away.

Upon inspecting the bag, airport personnel deduced that it was a roughly 500g pack of ground opium leaves, contraband by any legal measure in New Westmore. The tower was able to figure that NW-GFA, the airplane the three men are flying, must have been responsible for the bag. The tower already has a line of sight with their bandits, only aided by the plume of black smoke and the occasional burp of flames from the airplane's stricken left engine.

The air is tense. At any moment, that airplane could go careening and crash into the city below. They best hope that they manage to get back as soon as possible, preferably in one piece.

[quote=yzakastan;61531817]Itzak walked up to the representative and spoke in a thick Yzak accent, Are you here to take me to the university? Is this the place? His eyes briefly passed over the student, but he gave no acknowledgment yet.[/quote]
The old man looks towards Itzak "Ah...I see you speak sufficent brukalish young man, I was worried I would have to use my translator here, I don't know how to use these new fangled things you know, there always coming up with something else these-"

He stops himself

"Oh, pardon me, Im rambling. My name is Walter Pompert. Im the director of forigen admissions here, I thought I would swing by to pick you up myself, but yes. I m here to take you to NUDS." He gives a hardy laugh, violently coughing halfway through.

"Now...the Department of Education thought it would be a wonderful idea if you were paired with a new student from the area to help you uh...adjust to Wuloosya. Uh...what's your name again?" He says, looking over to the student

"...My name is Emilya...how could you forget that? Im literally...ugh forget it." Emilya looks at Itzak

"My name is Emilya, Emilya Vanbrek. I find it weird that I specifically was chosen for this...this is my first day as well. But I guess it was random." She says offering to shake his hand
